chunks: Al-Husayn ibn ʿUbayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn ʿAli ibn Mahbub, from al-ʿAbbas, from Abi Hammam, from Muhammad ibn Saʿid ibn Ghazwan, from al-Sakkuni, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from his forefathers عليهم السلام, who said:
There is no harm in his performing the prayer of the night and the day with one tayammum, so long as he does not invalidate it or find water.

key_terms.النَّهَارِ: the daytime period, indicating prayers of the day
key_terms.صَلَاةَ اللَّيْلِ: the prayer performed during the night
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection or legal problem
key_terms.مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ: so long as he does not enter a state that breaks ritual purity

ai.seo_question: Can a person perform multiple prayers with one tayammum?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that one tayammum may suffice for multiple salat, including prayers of the night and day. It remains valid unless the person enters a state requiring renewed purification or comes upon water.
